Turf Replacement

Replace thirsty turf with a water-wise yard

Lawns are one of the largest outdoor water users in Southern California. Turf replacement swaps grass for climate-appropriate plants, mulch and efficient irrigation, creating a yard that looks good with far less water.

Request a consultation (555) 010-0199
  • Significantly less outdoor water use
  • Lower ongoing maintenance than a traditional lawn

Options

Turf Replacement options we offer

Lawn removal

Removing existing grass and preparing the soil for a new, climate-appropriate landscape.

Climate-appropriate planting

Native and drought-tolerant plants, mulch and permeable surfaces suited to Southern California conditions.

Efficient irrigation

Drip irrigation and smart controls that deliver water directly to plant roots.

Benefits

Why upgrade

  • Significantly less outdoor water use
  • Lower ongoing maintenance than a traditional lawn
  • A landscape suited to the local climate
  • Guidance on program requirements, which may need approval before work starts

Is it time?

Signs this upgrade could help

  • Your lawn needs frequent watering to stay green
  • You are tired of mowing and lawn maintenance
  • Parts of your yard are patchy or rarely used
  • You want to lower your outdoor water use

Process

How your turf replacement project works

  1. Consultation

    We discuss your yard, goals and budget, and explain how turf replacement works.

  2. Site review & plan

    We measure the area, review site conditions and outline a plant and irrigation plan.

  3. Program check

    Some programs require pre-approval before any grass is removed. We review this with you first.

  4. Installation

    We remove the turf, install the new landscape and irrigation, and walk you through care.

Programs

Programs that may apply

Depending on your property and eligibility, these programs may support a turf replacement upgrade. We review the current details with you.

  • SoCal WaterSmart
  • MEA
  • CRP

Incentive amounts, eligibility and funding availability are determined by each program and can change. They are not guaranteed. We will review current program information with you before you commit to any work.

FAQ

Turf Replacement questions

Do I need approval before removing my lawn?

Some turf replacement programs require you to apply and be approved before removing any grass. We review this with you during the consultation so you do not lose eligibility.

Will my yard still look green?

Yes. Water-wise landscapes use a variety of drought-tolerant plants, textures and colors, and can be designed to be just as inviting as a lawn.

Is artificial turf included?

Program rules on artificial turf vary. We focus on living, climate-appropriate landscapes and can discuss your options during the consultation.
